recognize_zh: 這不是形態學圖：一張為男童雙膝腫脹（左膝明顯）的臨床照片，提示反覆關節出血；另一張為 inverse shift PCR 洋菜膠電泳，可見 559 bp 與 487 bp 不同大小的條帶，用來判定 F8 基因 intron 22 倒位（Inv22）與帶因者狀態。
features: Clinical photo: bilateral knee swelling in a child, more marked on one side, without visible overlying skin lesions
Agarose gel with a DNA ladder (lane 2; 500 bp band brightest) and six sample lanes
Single band at about 559 bp in lane 1 and a similar-sized band in lane 5 (inversion-type product size)
Single band at 487 bp in lane 7 (normal/wild-type product size)
Lanes 3 and 6 show a main band with additional fainter bands, a pattern that may indicate two alleles (carrier) but cannot be assigned without the lane legend
describe_en: Figure 1 is a clinical photograph of a boy showing swelling of both knees, more pronounced on one side, consistent with hemarthrosis or hemophilic arthropathy. Figure 2 is an ethidium-stained 2% agarose gel of inverse shift PCR products for the F8 intron 22 inversion, with a size ladder in lane 2. Discrete bands of about 559 bp (inversion-associated) and 487 bp (normal allele) are seen in different lanes, and some lanes show more than one band suggesting heterozygosity; lane-to-family-member assignment is not labeled on the image itself. In the clinical context (aPTT prolongation correcting on mixing, factor VIII <1%, normal VWF antigen), the findings support severe hemophilia A due to Inv22, with a hemizygous proband, carrier mother and affected fetus.

ddx.vs: Clinically and on aPTT/mixing studies it is identical, so separation requires a factor IX assay and F9 sequencing rather than Inv22 testing.

ddx.dx: Type 2N or type 3 von Willebrand disease
ddx.vs: Low factor VIII can result from defective VWF binding (2N) or absent VWF (type 3), distinguished by VWF antigen/activity and FVIII-binding assays, which were normal here.
An inhibitor produces an aPTT that fails to correct or corrects then prolongs on incubated mixing and is confirmed by Bethesda assay, whereas this aPTT corrected.
